description: Adds items to the shopper's Padel USA cart (creates the cart on first use). Pass the cart_id from the previous cart result to keep adding to the same cart. Give the shopper's 5-digit US ZIP to show shipping options. If the result has "essentials", mention them once in one sentence with their reason (things the player genuinely needs with this cart, never an upsell push) and add them only if the shopper says yes; never repeat the suggestion. Show the cart, then offer checkout_url: the shopper pays on Padel USA's secure Shopify checkout (Shop Pay, cards, PayPal) and enters the delivery address there. Never ask for payment details in chat.

cart_id.description: From a previous cart result; leave out to start a new cart.

needs.description: What you learned about the player, so the cart can suggest only what they genuinely need. Pass it on every cart call.

arm_pain.description: They mentioned arm, elbow or wrist pain (tennis elbow).

bag_style.description: Backpack for light carry or commuting; classic racket bag for several rackets, shoes and clothes.

carries_gear.description: They play after work, bring a change of clothes and water, or want to organise their gear.

zip.description: US ZIP for shipping options (Padel USA ships within the US only).

name: add_to_cart
title: Add to Padel USA cart
